Package com.sca4d.auth.engine.attempt

Class RedisAuthenticationAttemptStore

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.auth.engine.attempt.RedisAuthenticationAttemptStore
@Internal public final class RedisAuthenticationAttemptStore extends Object
使用 Redis TTL 保存认证尝试，并以自动续租的分布式锁串行修改同一尝试。
